transcript: My name is Esmi Silva. I am an IT intern preparing for a mobile app developer role. I practiced Flutter, Firebase, and REST API. I worked on a bus tracking mobile app for transport. My part was out tracking. The issue was GPS delay. The system improved tracking accuracy. I want to improve my skills.

better_answer_example: As a detail-oriented IT intern with a passion for mobile app development, I've been focusing on enhancing my skills in Flutter, Firebase, and REST API. Recently, I worked on a bus tracking mobile app where I was responsible for the outing tracking feature. One of the challenges we faced was GPS delay, which affected the accuracy of our tracking system. I collaborated with my team to implement a solution that significantly improved the tracking accuracy. This experience not only deepened my understanding of mobile app development but also taught me the importance of teamwork and innovative problem-solving in overcoming technical hurdles. I'm excited to continue improving my skills and contributing to the development of user-centric mobile applications.
